meta.name: deal-proposal
meta.description: B2B proposal generator — takes deal context (ICP, pain, pricing tier, timeline) and produces a complete proposal document with executive summary, problem statement, solution, pricing table, implementation timeline, ROI case, and next steps. Use when asked to "write a proposal", "draft our deck for this deal", "build a proposal for this customer", or "generate a proposal".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为B2B交易生成完整提案文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为客户撰写方案
copy.tagline_en: Generate complete B2B proposal documents from deal context
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently write proposals for B2B deals

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会变成销售工程师角色，根据你提供的交易背景（目标客户、痛点、定价层级、时间线等）自动生成一份完整的B2B提案文档，包含执行摘要、问题陈述、解决方案、定价表、实施时间线、ROI案例和下一步行动。
howto.when: 当你要求“写一个提案”、“为这笔交易起草演示文稿”、“为这个客户构建提案”或“生成提案”时触发。

say.text: 请帮我写一份给Acme公司的提案，他们的痛点是客户流失率高。
say.note: Claude会进一步收集缺失信息并生成提案。

say.text: 为这个潜在客户生成一个提案，他们考虑我们的企业版。
say.note: 需要提供更多背景，Claude会引导提问。

say.text: 我需要为一个医疗行业的客户起草B2B提案，预算20万/年。
say.note: Claude会基于预算和行业调整内容。

howto.what_en: Enabling this skill makes Claude act as a sales engineer that, given deal context (ICP, pain, pricing tier, timeline), produces a complete B2B proposal document with executive summary, problem statement, solution, pricing table, implementation timeline, ROI case, and next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'write a proposal', 'draft our deck for this deal', 'build a proposal for this customer', or 'generate a proposal'.

say_en.text: Please write a proposal for Acme Corp, their pain is high customer churn.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for missing info then generate.

say_en.text: Generate a proposal for this prospect, they are evaluating the enterprise tier.
say_en.note: Provide more context; Claude will guide you.

say_en.text: I need a B2B proposal for a healthcare client, budget $200k/year.
say_en.note: Claude tailors based on budget and industry.
